Advt. No.: Estt./PR-NT/03/2026                                                                                      Date: November 19, 2026 
IIIT Allahabad is an Institute of national importance declared under the act of Parliament to provide for Education and 
Research in IT focused and allied branches of Engineering, Technology, Applied Sciences & Management Studies. The 
Institute is in search of suitable Internal candidate for appointment on the following posts: 
 
 Sl. No. Name of the Post  Total no. of 
Promotional Vacancy Category Pay Matrix Level as per 7th CPC 
1 Deputy Registrar 01 UR Level-12 
2 Technical Officer (SS) 01 UR Level-11 
 Total Post 02   
 
 
Maximum Age Limit  
(Group/Post-wise) ‘A’ Sl. No. 1 -2 Age limit prescribed for the posts not applicable for regular 
employees of IIIT Allahabad. 
Mode of Appointments:   Sl. No. 1-2   :   The posts are to be filed on promotional basis  
The essential qualification and experience for the above post is as under: 
1 
Post : Deputy Registrar [01-Position] 
Essential Qualification 
with Experience 
08 years administrative experience as Assistant Registrar in PB-3 with GP Rs. 5400 / or  
Pay Matrix Level-10 as per 7th CPC. 
2 
Post : Technical Officer(SS)[01-Position] 
Essential Qualification 
with Experience 
B.E./B.Tech./M.Sc./MCA  with 08 years of experience as Technical Officer in PB-3 with 
GP-5400 ( Pay Matrix Level -10 as per 7th CPC)   
 
GENERAL INSTRUCTIONS TO THE CANDIDATES 
1. Candidates must ensure that they possess the essential qualifications and experience stipulated in the 
advertisement before applying.  
2. Mere fulfillment of the stated qualifications does not automatically entitle a candidate to be called for written 
test (if applicable) /presentation-cum-interview. Candidates are expected to provide all relevant details of 
qualifications and experience with supporting documents. 
3. If a candidate is found ineligible at any stage of the recruitment process, he/she shall be disqualified and their 
candidature will be cancelled forthwith. Hiding of information or submission of false/misleading inform ation 
shall lead to cancellation of candidature at any stage of recruitment. 
4. The Institute reserves the right to reject any application without assigning any reason whatsoever. 
5. Applications received in response to this advertisement will be scrutinized and only scrutiny-cleared applicants 
will be called for the selection process.  
6. Candidates belonging to SC/ST and OBC-NCL categories are required to attach attested copies of their Caste 
Certificate in the format prescribed by the Government of India with their application. 
7. Preference will be given to Persons with Disabilities (PwD), even where specific reservation is not indicated in 
the vacancy table, provided suitable PwD candidates are available and meet the prescribed eligibility criteria. 
8. The Institute reserves the right to assign/transfer the selected candidate to any section, department, or office 
within the Institute as per administrative requirements. 
9. The date of determining the eligibility of all candidates in every respect shall be the normal closing date of the 
advertisement (December 10, 2026, 05:00 PM). 
10. The final selection shall be based on the candidate's performance in the written test (if applicable) and 
presentation-cum-interview, along with their overall qualifications and experience. 
11. The screening and selection criteria sha ll be as per RPN & Prevailing practice followed for promotional 
recruitment.  
INDIAN INSTITUTE OF INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY ALLAHABAD 
ESTABLISHMENT SECTION 
 INTERNAL PROMOTIONAL VACANCY IN ADMINISTRATIVE & TECHNICAL CADRE   
 
Page 2 of 2 
 
12. Internal correspondence or representations will not be entertained  or replied to. Any attempt to influence the 
selection process shall lead to immediate disqualification of candidature. 
13. Candidates are required to complete the enclosed application form and attach all relevant, self -attested 
supporting documents. 
14. The complete application, along with all relevant supporting documents (duly self-attested), must be submitted 
by hand to the Deputy Registrar (Estt.), Establishment Section, Admin. Extension Block -I, West Wing, 
IIIT Allahabad  on or before December 10 , 2026, till 0 5:00 PM . The envelope containing the complete 
application should be superscribed with Application for the post of "_____________"(as applicable)  
(Promotional Vacancy) – Advt. No.: Estt./PR-NT/03/2026 dated 19.11.2026". 
15. Incomplete applications, applications without relevant supporting documents, or applications received after the 
closing date and time shall be summarily rejected. The Institute shall not entertain any request for extension 
or late submission. 
16. After submission, the applicant should retain a copy of the submitted application for their records. 
17. In case of any dispute, ambiguity, or claim arising out of this advertisement or the selection process, the 
decision of the Director, IIIT Allahabad shall be final and binding on all parties. 
18. Any legal pro ceedings in respect of any matter, claim, or dispute arising out of this advertisement and/or an 
application in response thereto can be instituted only in Prayagraj, and the courts/tribunals/forums at 
Prayagraj shall have sole and exclusive jurisdiction to try such cause/dispute.
